visual_review: Before reduced the logo to a single-stroke caret with a dot on a stem, losing the pill shapes. Now the front pill is outlined (width 10, round r5 caps), the back pill runs from its top-left down to a full circle at the bottom-left, and the pills overlap into the Ads A, as in the reference.
omissions: The back pill is slightly tapered rather than parallel-sided (exact tangency to the circle isn't reachable on the integer grid).
